reports.title: AIMA missed summons, still pending
reports.topic: what should I do still pending and missing the first call for the new title of residence for almost a year
reports.summary: People waiting on AIMA after a missed first summons say do not email daily. Use the contact form, then geral@aima.gov.pt once. Check spam for @aima.gov.pt and give employers the QR comprovativo while the file stays under review.

reports.title: Apps to install before going to China
reports.topic: app to install before to going to china
reports.summary: Travelers this month recommend a small stack, not a 12-app list: Alipay first, an HK/SG-routed eSIM instead of VPN-as-primary, WeChat as backup pay and chat, Amap or Apple Maps, and Trip.com for English bookings. DiDi, metro QR, and bikes live as Alipay mini-programs.

reports.title: VPN to download in China
reports.summary: Travelers still say install a VPN before landing because China app stores and provider sites are blocked. The 30-day shift is eSIM-first, with Astrill as the practitioner VPN pick, ExpressVPN as the first-trip download, and LetsVPN treated as the failed default.

reports.title: Best Inditex men's chains for price/quality
reports.topic: best chains for a men with good price quality on inditex
reports.summary: Inside Inditex, Massimo Dutti is the men's quality pick, Zara is the selective mid-ladder workhorse, and Pull&Bear/Bershka/Lefties win on cheap casual volume rather than longevity. Shop fabric labels and sales.

reports.title: Best price-value Xiaomi phones
reports.summary: Community and review consensus puts Xiaomi's best bang-for-buck in the midrange: POCO X7 Pro for performance, Redmi Note 15 Pro / Pro+ for balanced daily use, and POCO M8 Pro for cheaper value. August's Redmi Note 17 / Redmi 17 launches win on huge batteries but trade away all-rounder value.

reports.title: Affordable men's daily watches
reports.topic: price quality watches for a men at cheap price for daily use
reports.summary: Communities still recommend Casio beaters, Citizen Eco-Drive, Seiko 5, and Orient for cheap men's daily wear. Quartz wins for set-and-forget; Seiko/Orient for a first automatic. Japanese value brands dominate over fashion watches.

reports.title: Men's Summer Outfits 2026
reports.topic: every outfit for men in 2026 summer
reports.summary: Community and style guides agree summer 2026 menswear is a small remixable capsule: linen/camp collar/knit polo, tailored shorts, warm muted colors, and loafers or espadrilles. MFA outfit checks celebrate knit polos and roast layered looks in July heat.

reports.title: How to Search for Papers for Thesis
reports.topic: How to search for papers for thesis
reports.summary: Community guidance this month favors a layered search stack: Google Scholar or Semantic Scholar for entry, discipline databases for rigor, citation maps (ResearchRabbit/Litmaps) from seed papers, Elicit for structured extraction, and Zotero for organization. AI tools speed discovery but every claim still needs PDF verification; volume without notes is the most-cited failure mode.

reports.title: Best powerlifting squat programs
reports.topic: best powerlifting program for barbell squats
reports.summary: Community consensus picks programs by experience level: GZCLP for beginner-to-intermediate barbell squat progression, Calgary Barbell for meet-style peaking, and Russian Squat / Nuckols templates for squat specialization. Smolov stays the high-risk overreach option.

reports.title: Custom front-end UI for vibe coding
reports.topic: how to create my own front-end user interface for vibe coding
reports.summary: Builders are mostly forking or self-hosting CloudCLI (siteboon/claudecodeui) rather than inventing a vibe-coding shell from zero. DIY paths converge on spawn-CLI + WebSocket + React, while smaller wins include custom Claude Code status lines and design-token rules so agent-built UI does not look like AI slop.
